messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — new reserved-pool behavior doc is live: <https://redwood.app/s/rdv/reserve-redispatch> TL;DR: customer asks for spillover that keeps latency <150ms p95 during spikes by redispatching queued requests to an elastic pool and doing minimal prewarm. Need a product call on autoscale triggers, billing guardrails, and launch criteria.
Samir Patel: Link looks good, can you paste the short option set here?
Maria Chen: Summary pasted: Option A: aggressive prewarm + per-tenant soft quota (tokens billed from reserve). Option B: on-demand elastic spill with redispatch and ephemeral prewarm (billed at on-demand rate). Option C: hybrid — minimal prewarm + redispatch with throttles.
Katie O'Neill: Customer asks for predictability — they will pay for reserved headroom. Proposed launch criteria: 1) no SLO regressions vs baseline, 2) billing doc + examples, 3) oncall runbook and alerts.
Jordan Lee: Implementation note: redispatch has two modes: "steal" (migrate a running slot) vs "queue-bypass" (move from tenant queue to elastic pool). "Steal" risks KV-cache corruption; prefer queue-bypass for MVP.
eng-bot: deploy pipeline started for branch reserve-redispatch:build-2026-03-20 — CI passing ✅
Alex Rivera: Measurement plan: capture p95 latency, prewarm cost delta, and redispatch rate (#spilled / total). Suggest pilot with 5 tenants for 2 weeks.
Samir Patel: Complexity estimate: queue-bypass ~3w infra + 1w rollout policy. Prewarm hooks + heuristics another ~2w. MVP = queue-bypass + soft quota (scoped).
Maria Chen: MVP sounds right. Need product/legal on billing names and wording — @Katie can you lead the billing language?
Katie O'Neill: I'll draft billing language: "Reserved capacity covers baseline throughput; spillover to elastic billed at on-demand rates; customers on committed plans get monthly burst credits." I'll post a draft by EOD Friday.
Jordan Lee: Oncall impact: add metric "redispatch-failure-rate" and page if >0.1% sustained over 10m. Also require automatic fallback to a smaller model variant if redispatch saturates.
Maria Chen: Rollout plan: pilot 5 tenants -> alpha 50 -> GA. Launch criteria: pilot perf meets p95 within 10% of baseline, billing text approved, runbook + alerts in place, and one commercial customer committed for GA.
Samir Patel: Need tenant-level "spill_cap" to avoid noisy neighbor; default = 2.0x committed QPS.
Alex Rivera: I'll build a dashboard widget and example queries showing p95, spill rate, and cost delta. ETA 1w.
eng-bot: @samir_test created ticket #INF-4823 reserved-redispatch-queue-bypass
Maria Chen: Owners: Samir (infra), Alex (metrics), Katie (billing), Jordan (oncall). I'll sync with legal tomorrow and schedule a pilot kickoff.
Samir Patel: :thumbsup:
Katie O'Neill: Uploaded billing draft: <https://redwood.app/docs/billing/reserved-spill> — please review and give feedback inline.
Jordan Lee: Quick config example for clarity:
```
reserved_pool:
  spill_behavior: queue-bypass
  spill_cap: 2.0
  prewarm: minimal
  fallback_model: gpt-small-quant
```
Maria Chen: OK next steps — Samir, please create the MVP PR and tag @eng-oncall for rollout planning. I'll schedule a 30m sync with pilot customers on Tue.
Alex Rivera: Noted, prepping dashboards + alert queries.
eng-bot: Reminder: incident-runbook template updated at <https://redwood.app/ops/runbooks/redispatch>
Maria Chen: Thanks all — reconvene Fri 11:00 to review pilot readiness.
